prompt_text: I need a dental implant in Atlanta. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — to give you the best, usable list I just need one quick detail: what area of Atlanta or which ZIP code are you nearest to? (Also tell me if you have a preference: lower cost vs fastest treatment vs sedation/IV anesthesia vs full-arch reconstruction like All‑on‑4.)

If you want an immediate, general starting point before you give a ZIP code, call these three types of providers in Atlanta and why each is useful:

1) Emory University School of Dentistry (Emory Dental Center)
   - Why call: academic, multidisciplinary clinic (periodontics, prosthodontics, oral surgery). Good for complex cases and second opinions; faculty supervision and access to advanced imaging at reasonable cost compared with private specialists.

2) A hospital‑affiliated oral & maxillofacial surgery group (examples: Piedmont or Northside hospital oral surgery teams)
   - Why call: these groups handle the most complex surgical cases (impacted teeth, extensive bone grafting, IV sedation/general anesthesia). Good when you expect difficult surgery or need medical clearance.

3) A private periodontist or prosthodontist in Atlanta who specializes in implants
   - Why call: periodontists place implants and manage bone/gum health; prosthodontists focus on restoration (crowns, bridges, full‑arch). Look for practices that offer in‑office CBCT 3D imaging, guided implant placement, and an in‑house lab or strong lab partnerships.

What to ask when you call (so you can compare clinics quickly)
- Do you place and restore implants in‑house, or do you work with separate surgeons/restorations?
- Do you have CBCT 3D imaging on site?
- Do you offer guided surgery or same‑day provisional teeth (All‑on‑4 / immediate load)?
- What types of sedation do you offer (nitrous, oral, IV)?
- Do you perform bone grafting or sinus lifts if needed?
- How many implant cases do you place per month and can you show before/after photos or patient references?
- Do you accept my insurance, and what financing options are available?
- What is the estimated timeline and a ballpark cost range for the treatment I likely need?

If you tell me your ZIP code and any preferences (insurance, budget, sedation, single implant vs full arch), I’ll compile a short list (3–6 specific local practices with phone numbers and a one‑line reason to call each).
